rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML infrastructure, efficient inference, and transformer architectures aligns well with Sharon's focus on production-ready AI agent infrastructure. While Artem brings hands-on ML systems knowledge from open-source work and Nous Research, Sharon's team is building agentic AI solutions across biotech, healthtech, and fintech—domains that could benefit from the kind of optimized inference and vision-language model work Artem specializes in.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Sharon — you're both working on the infrastructure layer of modern AI systems, and Sharon's production agent platform could benefit from the kind of efficient inference and transformer optimization you've built.
